# Intelekta Skola

> SIA Intelekta Skola is an AI training and consulting company based in Riga, Latvia, serving both individuals (courses, mentoring, self-study guides) and businesses (AI strategy consulting, custom chatbots, document-processing agents, marketing content tools, data analysis/forecasting, and a social media automation service).

Intelekta Skola is registered in Latvia (Reg. No. 40203747500, VAT LV40203747500) and based at Akmeņu iela 21B, Rīga, LV-1048, Latvia. Contact: info@intelektaskola.lv, +371 20 771 001, WhatsApp https://wa.me/37120771001. The site is available in Latvian (primary), English, and Russian via a language switcher.

## Products — training (individuals)

- [AI ieviešanas ceļvedis (AI Implementation Guide)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/ai-ieviesana.html): A €20 self-study digital guide in three levels (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) covering AI foundations through to deploying solutions. Not a live, instructor-led course.
- [Individuālais AI kurss (Individual AI Course)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/individualais-ai-kurss.html): €150 personalized 1-on-1 mentoring covering ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Gemini, automation, and prompt engineering, tailored to the learner's goals and pace.
- [Promptu inženierija (Prompt Engineering)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/prompt-inzenierija.html): €159 course on structured prompt-writing for business, creativity, and automation, for repeatable, predictable results.
- [ChatGPT un LLM meistarība (ChatGPT & LLM Mastery)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/chatgpt-llm-meistariba.html): €500 advanced course on practical AI usage, prompting, workflows, and advanced ChatGPT/LLM techniques for professionals and teams.

## Products — business AI solutions (companies)

- [AI ieviešanas konsultācijas (AI Implementation Consulting)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/ai-konsultacijas.html): AI opportunity audits and team workshops. Entry consultation from €200; full audit €1000–€5000; workshop €500–€2000. Aimed at construction, manufacturing, and logistics companies deciding where to start with AI.
- [Biznesa gadījuma izpēte un ROI aprēķins (Business Case & ROI Analysis)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/biznesa-case-roi.html): A numbers-based business case and ROI calculation for AI investments, used for leadership buy-in and grant applications (e.g. LIAA). From €200 entry consultation; full analysis €1500–€4000.
- [AI čatboti biznesam (AI Chatbots for Business)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/ai-chatboti.html): Custom AI chatbots for customer service, order handling, or internal support, trained on the client's own data. From €200 entry consultation; custom chatbot from €5000.
- [Dokumentu apstrādes AI aģenti (Document Processing AI Agents)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/dokumentu-agenti.html): AI agents that sort, analyze, and draft responses to emails, invoices, and forms. From €200 entry consultation; full solution €3000–€15000.
- [AI satura ģenerēšanas rīki (AI Content Generation Tools)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/satura-generesana.html): A custom AI tool generating marketing copy, social posts, and product descriptions in natural Latvian. From €200 entry consultation; solution €2000–€8000 plus a monthly subscription.
- [Datu analīzes un prognozēšanas rīki (Data Analysis & Forecasting Tools)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/datu-analize-prognozes.html): AI-driven sales, inventory, and customer-behavior forecasting built on the client's own data. From €200 entry consultation; full solution from €8000.
- [AI automatizācija sociālajiem tīkliem (AI Social Media Automation)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/ai-automatizacija.html): €236.88/month ongoing service — Intelekta Skola's team creates, schedules, and publishes social media content using AI tools on the client's behalf. This is a done-for-you service, not a course.
- [Digitalizācija un procesu automatizācija (Digitalization & Process Automation)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/digitalizacija-automatizacija.html): Automates paper/spreadsheet-based business processes using tools like Microsoft Power Automate and SAP Business AI. From €200 entry consultation; project €5000–€50000. Eligible for LIAA grant co-financing.
- [AI modeļu pielāgošana un integrācija (AI Model Fine-Tuning & Integration)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/ai-modelu-pielagosana.html): Fine-tunes existing AI models (e.g. ChatGPT, Llama) on a client's specific data and industry terminology, and integrates them into IT infrastructure. From €200 entry consultation; project from €15000. Aimed at medium/large businesses with unique data.
- [Personāla apmācība un ieviešanas atbalsts (Staff Training & Implementation Support)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/personala-apmaciba.html): Hands-on staff training on using AI tools day-to-day, plus post-rollout support, so AI investments actually get used. From €200 entry consultation; training day €500–€3000.
- [Produkti (Products overview)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/produkti/): All products — training and business solutions — with pricing and links to detail pages.

## Free tools

- [Promptu darbnīca (Prompt Workshop)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/tools/prompt-darbnica/): Pick a business scenario and get a ready-made, professional AI prompt.
- [AI Laika kalkulators (AI Time Calculator)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/tools/laika-kalkulators/): Estimate hours and money a team can save per month by adopting AI.
- [AI Gatavības tests (AI Readiness Test)](https://www.intelektaskola.lv/tools/ai-gatavibas-tests/): A short quiz assessing how AI-ready a business is.
